title: Compactly supported cutoff equal to 1 on the cone X ∩ B₁(0) and vanishing on Q outside B̄_δ(0)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P with orthogonal projection p_Q (Q.starProjection), and let δ > 0. Then there is a continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ (an element of CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Euclid P) ℝ) such that 0 ≤ f ≤ 1 everywhere, f(y) = 1 whenever 2|p_Q y| < |y| and |y| < 1 (that is, on X ∩ B₁(0) with X = {y : 2|p_Q y| < |y|}), and f(y) = 0 whenever y ∈ Q and |y| > δ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∃ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Euclid P) ℝ, (∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) ∧ (∀ y, f y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y : Euclid P, 2 * ‖Q.starProjection y‖ < ‖y‖ → ‖y‖ < 1 → f y = 1) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Q, δ < ‖y‖ → f y = 0
